# EVOLVE Apparel

> Western-Canadian outdoor lifestyle apparel — the lifestyle arm of Evolve Eco Blasting. Heavyweight hoodies, tees, flannels, and caps, made to order and shipped across Canada and North America. Born in the Alberta trades, weather-tested, and unapologetically Canadian. Tagline: Prairies to Peaks. Earned outside.

EVOLVE makes rugged, premium-but-accessible apparel for proud, capable Canadians who live their lives outside — trades workers, hunters, anglers, hikers, snowboarders, and weekend escapees. The Evolve Journal is a library of deeply researched, no-fluff guides to getting outside in Canada: hikes, ski resorts, national parks, cabins, mountaineering, gear, survival skills, adventure sports, and breathtaking views.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://evolveapparel.shop/): brand overview and featured drop.
- [Shop](https://evolveapparel.shop/shop/): the full range — outerwear, tops, headwear, accessories.
- [Our Story](https://evolveapparel.shop/about/): the three brand stories and the link back to Evolve Eco Blasting.
- [The Evolve Journal](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/): every outdoor guide and field note.

## The Evolve Journal — outdoor guides
- [The 10 Best Places to Stay in Western Canada With a Breathtaking View From Your Room](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/best-places-to-stay-western-canada-views/): ten lodges and resorts in BC, Alberta, the Yukon and the NWT with the view from the room, prices checked October 2026, and how to get there.
- [The Long Haul: Canada's Greatest Road Trips, With the Gas Stations Nobody Warns You About](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/the-long-haul-canada-road-trips/)
- [Chasing Green: How and Where to See the Northern Lights in Alberta and Western Canada](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/northern-lights-alberta-western-canada/)
- [Steaming in the Bush: Western Canada's Best Natural Hot Springs (And the Ones Still Worth the Hike)](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/best-hot-springs-western-canada/)
- [No Mountains Required: The Best Hikes Within Two Hours of Edmonton](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/best-hikes-near-edmonton/)
- [Vancouver Island, End to End: Ten Places Worth the Ferry](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/vancouver-island-places/)
- [Learning to Climb in Canada: Where to Start Mountaineering](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/learn-to-mountaineer-canada/)
- [Pack Light, Eat Smart: The Beginner's Hike-Packing Kit](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/lightweight-hike-packing-kit/)
- [Descended from Survivors: Ten Backcountry Skills the First Canadians Knew](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/first-canadians-survival-skills/)
- [Deep Wild, Good Sheets: Five Canadian Nature Resorts](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/best-nature-resorts-canada/)
- [Cold and Free: Five Canadian Adventure Sports](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/canadian-extreme-sports/)
- [Build Your Own Off-Grid Escape: Cheap Land, Solar, and a Wood-Fired Soak](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/off-grid-cabin-canada/)
- [Stand Here: The Ten Most Breathtaking Views in Canada](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/best-views-canada/)
- [The Best Ski Resorts in Alberta](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/best-ski-resorts-alberta/)
- [The Best Hikes in Alberta and BC](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/best-hikes-alberta-bc/)
- [Ten Boutique Cabins and Lodges in Canada](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/boutique-cabins-canada/)
- [The 10 Best National Parks in Canada](https://evolveapparel.shop/journal/best-national-parks-canada/)

## About
- Brand: EVOLVE Apparel (also EVOLVE / EVOLVE Lifestyle / EVOLVE Outdoors).
- Parent company: Evolve Eco Blasting — abrasive blasting and surface restoration in Edmonton and across Alberta (https://www.evolveecoblasting.com).
- Based in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada; serves Canada and North America.
- Voice: proud, grounded, plain-spoken. "Polite. Until the work gets hard."
- Social: https://www.facebook.com/EvolveApparelCo
